caption: The drawing depicts a wooden corner cabinet with two main sections. The upper section has two glass-paned doors, each door featuring three vertical and two horizontal wooden muntins that divide the glass into six panels per door, revealing three interior shelves with a reddish-brown background. The lower section consists of two solid wooden doors, each door having a recessed rectangular panel with a beveled edge. The hinges and handles on both the upper and lower doors are visible and rendered in a metallic color. The cabinet has a crown molding along the top edge with dentil detailing and stands on short, slightly inset feet. The overall color of the wood is a light to medium brown, with variations in shading to indicate the wood grain and depth. The cabinet is set against a plain, off-white background, with a thin rectangular border drawn around the cabinet.
title: Corner Cupboard
